headline: Prime Minister Directs Banks to Genuinely Reduce Lending Interest Rates
summary: Vietnam's Prime Minister directed the banking system to keep lending rate levels stable, genuinely reduce lending rates and direct credit to the right sectors and recipients.
why: Government directives on lending rates shape borrowing costs across Vietnam's banking system and its corporate and household credit demand.
